entries.title: Luke 13:1
segments: ¶There were present at that season some who told Him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

entries.title: Luke 13:2
segments: And Jesus answered and said to them, "Do you suppose that these Galileans were worse sinners than all [other] Galileans, because they suffered such things?

entries.title: Luke 13:3
segments: "I tell you, no; but unless you repent you will all likewise perish.

entries.title: Luke 13:4
segments: "Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them, do you think that they were worse sinners than all [other] men who dwelt in Jerusalem?

entries.title: Luke 13:5
segments: "I tell you, no; but unless you repent you will all likewise perish."

entries.title: Luke 13:6
segments: ¶He also spoke this parable: "A certain [man] had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

entries.title: Luke 13:7
segments: "Then he said to the keeper of his vineyard, 'Look, for three years I have come seeking fruit on this fig tree and find none. Cut it down; why does it use up the ground?'

entries.title: Luke 13:8
segments: "But he answered and said to him, 'Sir, let it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize [it].

entries.title: Luke 13:9
segments: 'And if it bears fruit, [well]. But if not, after that you can cut it down.'"

entries.title: Luke 13:10
segments: ¶Now He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath.

entries.title: Luke 13:11
segments: And behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bent over and could in no way raise [herself] up.

entries.title: Luke 13:12
segments: But when Jesus saw her, He called [her] to [Him] and said to her, "Woman, you are loosed from your infirmity."

entries.title: Luke 13:13
segments: And He laid [His] hands on her, and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

entries.title: Luke 13:14
segments: But the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath; and he said to the crowd, "There are six days on which men ought to work; therefore come and be healed on them, and not on the Sabbath day."

entries.title: Luke 13:15
segments: The Lord then answered him and said, "Hypocrite! Does not each one of you on the Sabbath loose his ox or donkey from the stall, and lead [it] away to water it?

entries.title: Luke 13:16
segments: "So ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has bound--think of it--for eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the Sabbath?"

entries.title: Luke 13:17
segments: And when He said these things, all His adversaries were put to shame; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by Him.

entries.title: Luke 13:18
segments: ¶Then He said, "What is the kingdom of God like? And to what shall I compare it?

entries.title: Luke 13:19
segments: "It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and put in his garden; and it grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches."

entries.title: Luke 13:20
segments: And again He said, "To what shall I liken the kingdom of God?

entries.title: Luke 13:21
segments: "It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal till it was all leavened."

entries.title: Luke 13:22
segments: And He went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

entries.title: Luke 13:23
segments: ¶Then one said to Him, "Lord, are there few who are saved?" And He said to them,

entries.title: Luke 13:24
segments: "Strive to enter through the narrow gate, for many, I say to you, will seek to enter and will not be able.

entries.title: Luke 13:25
segments: "When once the Master of the house has risen up and shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and knock at the door, saying, 'Lord, Lord, open for us,' and He will answer and say to you, 'I do not know you, where you are from,'

entries.title: Luke 13:26
segments: "then you will begin to say, 'We ate and drank in Your presence, and You taught in our streets.'

entries.title: Luke 13:27
segments: "But He will say, 'I tell you I do not know you, where you are from. Depart from Me, all you workers of iniquity.'

entries.title: Luke 13:28
segments: "There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, and yourselves thrust out.

entries.title: Luke 13:29
segments: "They will come from the east and the west, from the north and the south, and sit down in the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Luke 13:30
segments: "And indeed there are last who will be first, and there are first who will be last."

entries.title: Luke 13:31
segments: ¶On that very day some Pharisees came, saying to Him, "Get out and depart from here, for Herod wants to kill You."

entries.title: Luke 13:32
segments: And He said to them, "Go, tell that fox, 'Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third [day] I shall be perfected.'

entries.title: Luke 13:33
segments: "Nevertheless I must journey today, tomorrow, and the [day] following; for it cannot be that a prophet should perish outside of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Luke 13:34
segments: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the one who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, as a hen [gathers] her brood under [her] wings, but you were not willing!

entries.title: Luke 13:35
segments: "See! Your house is left to you desolate; and assuredly, I say to you, you shall not see Me until [the time] comes when you say, 'Blessed is He who comes in the name of the LORD!'"
